description: A request becomes a priced quote in the client's own template: what was asked for is crossed against their price list, the arithmetic is the script's, and whatever is not on the list comes back with no price
client_copy: Arma el presupuesto con tu formato y tus precios, listo para que lo mandes.
_comment: IT DEPENDS ON deliverable BECAUSE THE SKILL RUNS IT BY PATH: step 5 is
all means the deliverable exists -- a quote pasted into the chat is a quote
AND ON approval BECAUSE THE SKILL NAMES IT: «Si además lo tenés que mandar
vos —por mail, por WhatsApp, al que preguntó— eso pasa por la skill
`approval`». Writing the quote needs no yes; sending it does, and so do a
delivery date, a new condition and a discount.
NO TOOLSET IS DECLARED. Reading an Excel or a photo of what has to be priced
is the base capabilities every agent already has -- the SKILL.md says «las
podés leer con lo que ya tenés» -- not something this plugin turns on.
